clips.send: A friend convinced only elected officials have real power - unease at hearing an unelected regulator can threaten to arrest the world's richest man.
clips.caption:
He said it almost in passing, between a story about gold bars and a headline about Elon Musk.

An EU regulator - nobody elected him, nobody can fire him - threatened to arrest the richest man on the planet over an interview. Why does an unelected desk clerk in Europe have that kind of power? Because, Kevin says, people like that don't answer to politicians. They answer to the Bilderberg group and the Brotherhood - and he says he used to be in that room himself.

The people you can vote out were never the ones in charge.

Comment RISE and I'll send you more of what he says happens in those rooms.
